messages.subject: Problem with Buildtemplate fuction.
parts:
Hi,

I'm having trouble with placing semilandmarks using the buildtemplate function. 

I'm trying to put landmarks and semilandmarks in a 3D models of a metacarpal. I can put the landmarks in the right position (although sometimes they get through the surface of the bone and they end up in the wrong places), but semilandmarks keep been misplaced. In the picture, I show you the place when semilandmarks should be placed (highlighted in yellow), and although it is hard to see, semilandmarks are located in the body of the bone.

I have read possible explanations to this problem and think that may have something to do with the vertices of the mesh. But, although I have tried some remeshing filters using Meshlab, no one seems to work. So, it is possible that my problem has nothing to do with the vertices.

I appreciate if someone has some pieces of advice to fix this problem!
